Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vibhendu Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Learned counsel for the applicants is permitted to delete the applicant nos.4 and 5 from the array of parties, during the course of the day.

2. Heard Sri Vibhendu Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Brijesh Kumar Dwivedi,
learned AGA for the State.
3.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.26787 of 2020 (Smt. Risha Vs. Rahul Gupta & Others), under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act, Police Station-Kavinagar, District-Ghaziabad, pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C., Court No.1, Ghaziabad as well as summoning order dated 18.08.2022.

sentences.text:
4. Contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that dispute between the parties is Rahul Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78508332/
1 matrimonial in nature and they have settled their dispute amicably and a written compromise dated 23.09.2023 was also entered into between the parties.

entities.text: Rahul Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is further submitted that on the basis of the aforesaid compromise, parties have filed an application under Section-13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for getting divorce on the basis of mutual consent and request is made that on the basis of the aforesaid compromise, proceeding may be quashed.
5.
However, learned AGA has pointed out that compromise which has been annexed at page no.51 is yet to be verified by the concerned court.

6. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction that applicants will file the aforesaid compromise before the court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C., Court No.1, Ghaziabad, within a period of 15 days and the court below will verify the same after summoning the parties.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C., Court No.1, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Thereafter, on verification of the aforesaid compromise,
court below will terminate the impugned proceeding on the basis of compromise.
7. The aforesaid exercise shall be concluded by the court below, within a period of three months.
8. For a period of three months, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
